assumptions: the pinned artifacts named by the manifest are the ones the review actually read — their sha256 is verified against bytes on disk, and INV-R9.2 recomputes the delta from those bytes, but nothing establishes that a human read the thing whose hash matches
the substrate executed the check as written (ASM-SUBSTRATE-INTEGRITY)
attrs.evidence: The mechanism is implemented and every clause of it is exercised by a registered mutation. What INV-R9.3 removes is the UNIVERSAL reading: GPT-5.6 measured that the disposition domain covers source ADDITIONS and MODIFICATIONS and not DELETIONS. integration-delta.mjs computes dropped_ids and removed_files; candidatePopulation disposes only candidate_ids and filePopulation only changed_files, so a future source-lane deletion is not a disposition at all, and the collision test counts a canonical change only where the predecessor record still exists, so canonical deletions are not dual-lane changes either. For the INV-R7.5 instance both are ZERO — dropped_ids 0, removed_files 0 — which is why the instance result stands and is recorded separately as FAC-INTEGRATION-R9-DELTA. The generic claim is DECLARED until FAC-INTEGRATION-DELETION-COMPLETE closes.
attrs.gap: THE REVIEW ITSELF IS AUTHORITY, NOT PROOF: the gate establishes that the population disposed of is the population the materials produce, not that a person read it. And the domain is additions and modifications only. A universal reading of this record would be exactly the overclaim INV-R9.3 exists to withdraw.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6's Phase C protocol. The git ancestry / promotion predecessor / content source separation is Fable 5's FAC-CONTENT-PARENT, rewritten per the adjudication's §4.
attrs.review_focus: Is DECLARED the right status for an implemented mechanism, or does it under-sell a design whose every clause has a live falsifier? The alternative is a scoped PROVED, and this ledger has no vocabulary for `proved over this domain and silent outside it` — which may itself be the gap.
attrs.statement: Cross-lane integration imports reviewed content and evidence and never source-lane authority: the delta is computed against the SOURCE lane’s own baseline, applied to an isolated candidate rooted in clean canonical ancestry, and every candidate record is accounted for against a population derived from the pinned materials rather than declared by the manifest. THIS IS THE DESIGN. It is not a proof that the design is complete for every future delta.
